# LoCoMo evaluation input

`locomo10.json` and `LICENSE.txt` are copied without modification from the
official [`snap-research/locomo`](https://github.com/snap-research/locomo)
repository at commit `3eb6f2c585f5e1699204e3c3bdf7adc5c28cb376`.

| File | SHA-256 |
|---|---|
| `locomo10.json` | `79fa87e90f04081343b8c8debecb80a9a6842b76a7aa537dc9fdf651ea698ff4` |
| `LICENSE.txt` | `41003d4a74749c0220e33dd415042164b5a1093ed401f36277234f772d22d3d0` |

The upstream dataset is licensed under CC BY-NC 4.0. It contains 10 long
conversations and 1,986 question-answer items. The project runner defaults to a
fixed 100-question smoke subset and must not describe that subset as a full
LoCoMo result.
